craft_notes: Sthāyin: seer-joy (nothing over). Sanskrit first: participle + verb + rhetorical kim → L4 keeps seeing, dash, zero. Rows: row 3 (what/else frame). Rupture: semicolon after self — seeing done, remainder asked. Close: end-weight on else (the zero word). Minimal pass: 'by none but self' for ātmanā (reflexive sung). Read aloud: sees, settles, else? Rejected: 'himself by himself' flat — kept? L4 varies (none but self) for music; 'what is left' prose — killed: remains kept? L4 says 'what remains else' — kept.

lines: Ever awake, he sees himself by none but self;
settled in his own form — what remains else?
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvadā suprabuddhas san paśyaty ātmānam ātmanā / draṣṭuḥ svarūpasaṃsthasya kim anyad avaśiṣyate

reads_against.argmap: Always fully awake, he sees self by self; for the seer in own form, nothing else remains.
c1_essence: Always awake: self seen by self; nothing else remains.
